VASSAL.build.module.StartupGlobalKeyComm.name: Start up message & set global constants (Vassal workaround to allow maintenance of GPs used as constants in pre-set scenarios)
VASSAL.build.module.StartupGlobalKeyComm.reportFormat:
{prefNoWelcome!=true ?Alert("

Commands & Colors: Napoleonics Epic, Version 3.0

This module update automates card handling and enhances marker functionality for ease of play.

The Allies or French player may set the game to allow a different player count from the default (Epic only); each Corps Commander player must also press the Join Game button on screen or in that Corp Commander's hand window.

6/8 Player games only: Commander-in-Chief (Allies and French) allocates Tactician Card draws when prompted, by button press or equivalent right-click command.

To start a game, the \"Move First\" C-i-C player presses the \"Deal Cards\" button or equivalent right-click command.

Hints & Tips
Card Play: Use the right-click commands to play Cards. This avoids potential for cards to be placed into the wrong part of the board which can compromise automated card management for End Turn and Counter-Attack functions.

Stacking: Most commands are available from the topmost stacked piece but to access a stacked unit, select the stack and press left-arrow. To re-stack, press left-arrow again. Some commands automatically re-stack.

General: Unit and Leader commands are context sensitive by default. This keeps menus short and reduces errors. This means that some commands are only available before a unit is Ordered (March Move, Garrison - where valid - and Recover Hit) or when a unit has a combat marker on it (e.g. Take Hits and Square). Press F1 for a list of common commands and shortcuts.

This welcome message can be disabled from Preferences, Game Options.... Find further assistance via the resources under the Help drop-down menu.

"):""}
